description: The person's global risk limits (per-trade risk, daily / weekly / monthly loss, drawdown, leverage, open positions) and how much of each is used, across all exchanges, plus limit increases waiting to take effect. Use when a trade was rejected by a user-level limit or before planning several trades. Not for this agent's own permissions (use get_my_trading_permissions). No inputs. Fractions of equity and USD; real money and the sandbox are counted separately. Next: size_position.
name: get_my_risk_limits

book.description: real or sandbox: the two are counted separately

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

drawdown.description: Drop from peak equity, as a fraction

limits.description: max_risk_per_trade, loss limits and max_drawdown as fractions; max_leverage; max_open_positions; symbols

pending_loosening.description: Limit increases a person asked for that are not in force yet

realized_pnl.description: Realised profit or loss for day / week / month (UTC), USD

title: My risk limits and usage
